description: This file defines the PasswordHasher class used for hashing passwords within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including algorithm mapping, password hashing, and support for different hash algorithms.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: A utility class for hashing passwords with support for multiple algorithms, including custom and standard hash functions.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Maps an Excel protection algorithm name to a PHP hash algorithm name.

methods.name: defaultHashPassword
methods.description: Generates a password hash using a custom bitwise algorithm.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Creates a hashed password using specified algorithm, salt, and spin count.
